pr_title: Ensure System.Text.Json SG diagnostics don't use Location values from referenced assemblies.
pr_body:
Following up on https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/88152, this PR:

* Fixes #88424
* Add a diagnostic warning on `JsonSerializableAttribute` annotations not on classes deriving from `JsonSerializerContext`.

cc @layomia since the ConfigurationBinder might need to make a similar change.

issue_context.title: Ensure System.Text.Json SG diagnostics don't use locations from external assemblies
issue_context.body:
We can consider making a type annotated with `[OptionsValidator]` to be a fallback in that case (worst case scenario is when a validator is applied on a type residing in another assembly).
For JSON source-gen, a class annotated with `[JsonSerializable]` can be considered as a fallback location.

_Originally posted by @xakep139 in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/88396#discussion_r1253262179_
